title: Chapter cards (swipe deck)
description: One file per chapter: content/<class>/<stream>/<subject>/<chapter>/cards.json. 8–15 cards. Front = visual + title; back = 1–3 lines.

id.description: Stable id; never rename (it keys the Recall schedule and My cards).

svg.description: Inline <svg viewBox=…>…</svg> (currentColor, unit colour via class="u"/"uf", #E0B400 accent) or "ref: notes#<figure-or-block-id>" to reuse a drawing in notes.md.

tex.description: Formula cards: the formula in KaTeX, shown big on the front (no $ signs).

legend.description: Formula cards: "symbol = meaning" lines shown in colour under the formula. KaTeX allowed in the symbol.

back.description: 1–3 lines: what to notice, the exam point, the formula in words, or the trick. Markdown, $…$ and \ce{…} allowed.
